svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: TabSil on other tasks, zero-shot
svg.desc: Four panels, TabSil highlighted against the baselines of each benchmark. Forecasting (fev-bench): SQL Elo 1535, place 5 of 10. Outlier detection (ADBench): mean AUROC 0.663, 9th of 12 by Elo. Treatment effects: S-learner out-of-sample sqrt(PEHE) 0.55 ± 0.09 on IHDP and 0.54 ± 0.11 on ACIC 2016. Imputation (OpenML, MCAR): NRMSE 0.546 at 10% to 0.745 at 50% masked.
svg.text: SQL Elo with 95% CI · higher is better
out-of-sample √PEHE ± s.e. · log scale · lower is better
mean AUROC (0.5 is chance) · higher is better
TabSil places 9th of 12 methods by Elo.
Shown: the three highest-Elo methods and TabSil.
NRMSE at 10% and 50% of cells masked · lower is better
